Convert beta values to M values

Source: R/ngs_dnam.R
beta2M.Rd

Convert beta values to M values

Usage

beta2M(x, alpha = 1e-06)

Arguments

x

scalar, matrix, or data frame of beta values

alpha

a small number to avoid log(0), default is 1e-6

Value

M values

Examples

beta2M(meth_df)
#>               sample_1      sample_2      sample_3      sample_4      sample_5
